lines: 2017 年，八位作者写了一篇论文，标题就是论点。
In 2017, eight authors published a paper whose title was the argument.
论文题目直译过来，是你需要的只有注意力。
Its title translates to: attention is all you need.
他们把循环整个删掉，一次都没有留下。
They removed recurrence entirely, leaving not a single loop.
删掉之后，翻译效果更好，而且训练可以并行。
The result was better quality, and training could run in parallel.
这一章拆开这个结构：几个旧零件，一种新组合。
This chapter takes the structure apart: old parts, new combination.
拆完你会发现，核心只有一次打分，和一次加权。
What remains is one scoring step and one weighted sum.
第 4 章的注意力，是解码器看编码器，跨两条序列。
Chapter 4's attention had the decoder look at the encoder.
Transformer 把它改成同一条序列内部互相看。
The Transformer turns it inward: one sequence looks at itself.
这叫自注意力：句子里每个词，都去看所有词。
This is self-attention: every word looks at every word.
每个词要回答三个问题。第一，我在找什么？
Each word answers three questions. First: what am I looking for?
第二，我有什么可以被找到？第三，被找到后我提供什么？
Second: what can be found in me? Third: what do I hand over?
对应查询、键、值三个向量，都从同一个词向量变出来。
Query, key and value all come from the same word vector.
三个矩阵都是可训练参数，没有一个是手工设定的。
All three matrices are trained; none is hand-set.
小明把书放在桌上，因为它太重了。这个它，指书还是桌子？
Xiaoming put the book on the table because it was heavy. Which one?
它这个位置的查询，会去和句子里每个键打分。
The query at it scores against every key in the sentence.
如果书的键得分更高，它就会吸收更多书的信息。
If the book's key scores higher, it absorbs more of the book.
后面几层据此判断，重说的是书，不是桌子。
Later layers conclude that heavy is about the book.
这就是消解指代，在机制层面长出来的样子。
That is coreference resolution, grown at the mechanism level.
不是靠语法规则，是靠训练出来的匹配。
Not by grammar rules, but by learned matching.
结构没变，只是检索的两端，从两条序列变成了一条。
Same structure; only the two ends now live in one sequence.
把第 4 章那个小型神经网络打分，换成最简单的点积。
Replace the small scoring network with a plain dot product.
先拿查询矩阵，乘上键矩阵的转置，得到一张分数表。
Multiply queries by transposed keys to get a score table.
这张表是 n 乘 n 的，n 就是序列长度。
The table is n by n, where n is the sequence length.
点积衡量方向一致性：两个向量越同向，得分越高。
A dot product measures alignment: same direction, higher score.
接着按行做 softmax，每一行变成一组和为 1 的权重。
Then softmax each row into weights that sum to one.
最后乘上值矩阵，按权重把每个位置的内容加起来。
Finally multiply by values and add them up by weight.
这就是缩放点积注意力，一行公式说完了检索。
That is scaled dot-product attention: retrieval in one line.
注意，缩放发生在 softmax 之前，不在之后。
Note the scaling happens before softmax, not after.
那个根号是干什么的？先做一个能手算的假设。
What is that square root for? Start with a hand-checkable case.
假设查询和键的每个分量，均值是 0，方差是 1。
Assume every component of query and key has mean 0, variance 1.
点积是 64 项相加，方差累加起来就是 64。
The dot product sums 64 terms, so its variance is 64.
方差是 64，开根号之后，标准差大约是 8。
Take the square root: the standard deviation is about 8.
也就是说，分数会散在正负 24 这个范围里。
So scores scatter across roughly minus 24 to plus 24.
这么大的数喂给 softmax，权重会直接贴到 0 和 1。
Fed such large numbers, softmax pins weights to 0 or 1.
而 softmax 在饱和区，梯度几乎是 0。
And in the saturated region its gradient is nearly zero.
梯度没了，参数就学不动。第 4 章的消失问题，又回来了。
No gradient, no learning: Chapter 4's vanishing problem returns.
除以根号 dk，就是把方差从 64 拉回 1。
Dividing by the square root of dk pulls variance back to 1.
分数回到正常范围，softmax 就待在还有梯度的区域。
Scores return to a normal range, so softmax keeps its gradient.
所以缩放不是为了数值稳定，是为了别让 softmax 提前饱和。
The scaling is not about stability; it keeps softmax unsaturated.
这是工程细节决定成败的例子：删掉这个根号，训练会明显变差。
Remove that root and training gets noticeably worse.
一句话：先缩放，再做 softmax，别让注意力过早锁死。
Scale first, then softmax; do not let attention lock up early.
一组查询、键、值，只能学出一种相关性。
One set of queries, keys and values learns one kind of relation.
可语言里的关系很多：主谓、指代、语义相近、位置邻近。
Language has many: subject-verb, reference, similarity, proximity.
多头注意力：把 512 维切成 8 份，每份 64 维。
Multi-head attention splits 512 dimensions into 8 heads of 64.
每个头独立做一次注意力，各自看一个子空间。
Each head runs its own attention in its own subspace.
最后把 8 个头拼起来，再过一个线性层，合成一个向量。
Concatenate the 8 heads; one linear layer merges them.
总计算量和一个 512 维的单头差不多，表达能力更强。
Total compute is about that of one 512-wide head, but richer.
但分工不是人指定的，是训练完自己长出来的。
Nobody assigns the roles; they emerge after training.
还有一个约束不能忘：语言模型不许看未来。
One constraint remains: a language model may not see the future.
位置 3 如果看到位置 4 的词，那就是作弊。
If position 3 could see position 4, that would be cheating.
办法是因果掩码：softmax 之前，把右上三角设成负无穷。
The fix is a causal mask: set the upper triangle to minus infinity.
这样位置 t 只能注意到小于等于 t 的位置。
Then position t can only attend to positions up to t.
于是训练时，一整句话的所有位置可以同时算。
So in training, all positions of a sentence are computed at once.
一次前向传播，就得到 n 个位置的预测，和 n 个损失。
One forward pass gives n predictions and n losses.
循环网络不行，必须算完第一个状态，才能算第二个。
An RNN cannot: state two has to wait for state one.
同样的显卡，它能同时算更多位置。
The same GPU can work on many positions at once.
自注意力还有个数学性质：它对输入顺序是等变的。
Self-attention is permutation equivariant: order does not enter.
把句子打乱，每个词对所有词的加权和，本身不会变。
Shuffle the sentence; the weighted sums themselves do not change.
因为点积只看向量方向，不知道谁在前、谁在后。
A dot product sees direction, not who comes first.
所以位置信息必须显式加进去，第 3 章已经讲过。
So position must be added explicitly, as Chapter 3 explained.
原论文把正弦编码，直接加到词向量上，再一起送进网络。
The paper adds sine-cosine codes to the word vectors.
这里不重讲，只记住一句：少了它，词序信息就丢了。
We will not repeat it: without position, word order is gone.
现在把零件装起来。一个 Transformer 层，只有两个子层。
Now assemble. One Transformer layer has just two sublayers.
第一个子层是多头自注意力，负责位置之间交换信息。
The first is multi-head attention: exchange across positions.
第二个子层是前向网络，对每个位置独立变换，不跨位置。
The second is a feed-forward net, applied per position.
它先把维度升到四倍，过一层非线性，再降回来。
It expands to four times the width, then projects back.
两个子层外面都套着残差：把输入原样加回输出。
Both sublayers wear a residual: add the input back to the output.
原论文先做子层，再归一化，这个顺序叫 Post-LN。
The paper normalizes after each sublayer: Post-LN.
后来的大模型多半改成 Pre-LN：先归一化，再做子层。
Later models mostly switch to Pre-LN: normalize first.
好处是残差路径上没有归一化，梯度能直通底层，深层更稳。
The residual path stays unnormalized, so deep layers train better.
这套结构看起来很规整，但代价也很直接。
The structure is clean, but the price is explicit.
注意力要算一张 n 乘 n 的分数表，格数是长度的平方。
Attention builds an n by n table: entries grow as n squared.
所以自注意力的计算量，是 n 的平方乘 d。
So self-attention costs n squared times d.
序列长度翻倍，计算量和内存都变成 4 倍。
Double the length and both compute and memory quadruple.
前向网络是 n 乘 d 的平方，只随长度线性增长。
The feed-forward net costs n times d squared: linear in length.
序列很短的时候，前向网络才是主要开销。
For short sequences, the feed-forward net dominates.
长序列时，注意力迅速成为瓶颈，长上下文因此很贵。
For long ones attention is the bottleneck, so long context is costly.
最后澄清两个常见误解，两个都值得记。
Two common misunderstandings are worth clearing up.
第一，注意力权重看起来很直观，但它不等于解释。
First: attention weights look intuitive, but they are not explanation.
有些头确实学出了句法角色，也有很多头的作用至今说不清。
Some heads do learn syntax; many others remain unexplained.
第二，多头不是几个小模型投票的集成。
Second: multi-head is not an ensemble of models voting.
它们共享同一份输入，拼接之后再投影，是一个整体。
They share one input, concatenate, then project: one whole.
这些分工是训练涌现的，不是谁设计出来的。
The division of labour emerges in training, it is not designed.
所以别把一张注意力热图，直接当成解释。
So do not read an attention heat map as an explanation.
这一章之后，架构已经有了：注意力、多头、残差、前向网络。
The architecture is in place: attention, heads, residuals, FFN.
但它 2017 年刚出来时，只是用来做翻译的。
But in 2017 it was only a translation model.
真正让它变成通用底座的，是训练范式的转变。
What made it a general foundation was a change of paradigm.
先在海量无标注文本上预训练，再拿去做具体任务。
Pretrain on huge unlabeled text, then adapt to specific tasks.
下一章讲预训练：GPT 和 BERT 的故事。
Next chapter: pretraining, the story of GPT and BERT.
那是它从翻译模型，变成通用底座的一步。
That is the step from translation model to general foundation.
